memberdef.name: TensorVariable

detaileddescription.para: Computes eigenvalues and eigenvectors assuming that the tensor variable is symmetric. If not symmetric, off-diagonal elements are averaged. No check of symmetry is performed.
By default the length of the eigenvectors is equivalent to the eigenvalues but it can be normalized to one.

sect1.title: Input Arguments
sect1.para: Flag to normalize length of eigenvectors.

Eigenvalues and vectors are returned into the supplied Vector and TensorVariables, respectively.
Will return false if the rank of the matrix is zero.

sect1.title: Implementation
sect1.para: Just uses the normal binomial root formula.
